name: Genome Inversion Benchmark (simple & complex)
description: Provides benchmarks to evaluate detection of simple and complex genomic inversions, assessing tool accuracy, breakpoint resolution, and false discovery rates.
reputation: A specialized research benchmark with moderate adoption among structural-variation and bioinformatics tool developers.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; ground-truth for complex inversions can be ambiguous (breakpoint resolution uncertainty). Performance varies widely between simple and complex inversions; small/curated datasets and potential contamination or alignment artifacts can bias results.
